paper_metadata.title: Solid-solution hardening of Ir by Pt and Ni

evidence.quote: To understand the solid-solution hardening effect of Pt and Ni to Ir, compressive strength and compressive creep properties were investigated for Ir – Pt, Ir – Ni, and Ir – Pt – Ni alloys.

To improve the ductility and increase the high-temperature strength and creep properties of Ir, fcc single-phase Ir alloys containing additions of ductile Pt and Ni were chosen in this study.
These results showed that addition of Pt and Ni had a solid-solution hardening effect on pure Ir.

The lattice parameter change as a function of composition of Pt or Ni showed that the size misfit of Ni is larger than that of Pt in Fig. 1. Thus, the solid-solution hardening effect was higher in the alloy containing Ni than that in the alloy containing Pt, as shown in Figs. 2 and 3 .
